\
        # External reference code

        This directory contains third-party reference implementations used by the research code:

        - `ultralytics/`: vendored YOLOv8 framework snapshot.
        - `simsiam/`: original SimSiam reference implementation.

        The project package in `src/simsiam_yolo/` contains the repository-specific implementation. Keep local experiments, generated weights, datasets, and run outputs outside this directory.
